arguments.text: 8000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250, 2500, 3750, 5000, 6250, 7500 m). Pacer sets effort from the POD reserve. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: watch pod power vs boat-model power, GPS speed and heart rate for pod drift; fix with set_belief pod_gain. (2) weed/drag: push_local drop within a leg -> clear_rudder (pacer also does this). (3) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell paddler. (4) listen to the paddler, treat as evidence. (5) near finish: make sure pod reserve reading is right so the finish push fires if it should. Baseline the ratios after the start settles (minutes 3-8).

arguments.text: Baseline leg 1 (out), race s 180-305: pod 233 W, boat 150 W, GPS 3.41, rate 59.6, HR 167 (+0.75/min, levelling). pod/boat ratio ~1.50-1.60 (pre-race test ratio 206/133=1.55). Hull fit share 0.65 (weak, one direction). push_local fell 0.14->0.06 over leg 1 (watch: weed, pod drift, or current). Paddler went out hard; pod reserve 39% at 310 s; pacer said ease at 110 s.

arguments.text: Pacer ease rule alerts are edge-triggered: fired once at 110 s and not again though the paddler stayed ~224 W vs test CP 206 (condition stayed true). Open question at 8 min: is test CP low (HR flat ~169) or is paddler heading for a blow-up (~780 s pod reserve reads empty)? Watches pod_empty and blowup set to decide.

arguments.text: One back-stroke to clear the rudder, then straight back on.

831 s (2792 m): paddler said legs going, close to limit. Since the turn at 2500 m (744 s) push_local fell from ~0.0 to -0.09/-0.10 (leg 1 same direction was +0.07): boat ~5% slower at same pod power, starting AT the turn (pacer within-leg rule would miss it). Hypotheses: weed caught at turn / wind shift / tired blade. Sent clear_rudder at 831 s as a test: if push_local recovers to ~0, it was weed. If not, compare leg 4 (back): wind shift would raise push_local there; blade fatigue lowers both.

arguments.reason: check if clear_rudder restored push_local (weed test)
